name: Crowded-short funding RESET squeeze (negative-funding gate ARMS, RSI turn-up TRIGGERS the long)
rationale: Funding-as-crowding done RIGHT (not funding-carry). Deeply NEGATIVE perp funding means shorts are crowded and paying to hold the short — a positioning extreme that historically precedes relief rallies / short-squeezes in mid-cap majors. Funding is used ONLY as a regime GATE that arms a long; the actual entry is a price-stabilization TRIGGER (RSI crossing up out of oversold) so we never catch a falling knife. Long-only spot rides the squeeze up. DISCONFIRMERS the gate must beat on net deflated Sharpe: (1) plain reversion control = same RSI cross_up trigger with NO funding gate (proves funding adds signal over buy-the-dip); (2) funding-carry baseline = long whenever funding negative with no price trigger (the KNOWN-FAILED approach this must beat); (3) funding LEVEL as a continuous lt signal = the DRIFTING-level trap (handled by gating the level + requiring a cross_up confirmation rather than trading the raw level).
catalyst: crowded-short capitulation: extreme-negative perp funding while price stabilizes (RSI turns up out of oversold)
